Why “Magellan”?

In 1519, Ferdinand Magellan’s expedition set out to do something no one had ever done — sail all the way around the world. Three years later the survivors came home, and for the first time the whole planet was proven reachable. The map stopped being a rumor and became a place you could actually go.

Five centuries on, the map is open but the prices are not. Airfare is deliberately confusing — the same seat swings hundreds of dollars with no explanation. Magellan Flights pulls back that curtain. We put the real numbers in your hands, judge every fare against its own history, and hand the freedom of travel back to ordinary people.

What we actually do

Three jobs, every single day — so you don’t have to refresh a dozen booking sites hoping to get lucky.

1 · We track

We watch one-way and round-trip fares from 484 US routes to 161 countries, refreshed several times a day — a living market of real, bookable prices.

2 · We judge

Every fare is measured against that route’s own price history — its Standard Meridian. That’s how we know a $300 ticket to Europe is a genuine steal and a $300 ticket next door is not.

3 · We flag & alert

When a price drops well below normal we flag it BUY (88 today) and, if you ask, email you the moment it happens — so you book at the low instead of the average.

How to read a price

Every deal carries a colored bar showing where today’s fare sits against this route’s normal range.

Low

A great deal

Well below this route’s typical price — a genuinely good moment to book.

Typical

A fair price

Around the route’s usual range. Fine to book, though a dip may still come.

High

Above normal

Higher than this route usually runs. History suggests it’s likely to fall — worth waiting.

Prices refresh several times a day, and each fare’s live price is confirmed when you book on Aviasales — the figures here are a guide from recent history, so the deal you see is the deal you get.

Our promise to you

Prices refreshed through the day — never stale.

Where we’re headed

Magellan started as one traveler’s spreadsheet and became a daily market for the rest of us. We’re building the place you check first — where a fair price is obvious, a real deal is unmistakable, and the next trip is always one search away. Thanks for traveling with us.
